0022600107.text: The Hawks, 2-0 and first in the Southeast and the East, host the Rockets, who are also 2-0 and sit first in the Southwest and third in the West. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (fractured foot), while Houston is missing Reed Sheppard (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Houston won the last meeting 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026, part of a 2-0 sweep of the 2025-26 season series.
